The API's USD-valued constituent amounts produce the rounded full-composition weights recorded here: OpenEden TBILL 79.57%, BUIDL 9.23%, RLUSD 8.10%, VBILL 2.92%, and USDC 0.18%. Zero-balance USYC, BENJI, and pending-USDC fields do not create slices.
